runtime.database: isolated temporary embedded PostgreSQL using packaged PostgreSQL 18.4

observed_contract: POST /api/orgs/:id/workspace/backups returned 201 with the native archive path enabled.
GET workspace backup download returned 200 with application/zip.
After changing the live workspace, POST restore with confirm=true returned 200 and restored before\n.
limitations: This receipt proves the packaged server/runtime backup path only; it is not packaged Desktop authenticated acceptance.
APFS/Windows interruption, malformed/corrupt/failure recovery, and the full size/count mutation matrix remain open.
The Desktop account gate cannot be bypassed in a packaged build; no credentials or authenticated session were used.
provenance: delegated independent packaged-resource audit plus local artifact identity/hash recheck
